pattern: KR-10 provider reports the lock replaced and promises the remaining keys to the office tomorrow; record the result and track the keys rather than closing on a promise
notes: Real cut, no edits: the agent sees events 001-020; the last visible events (Friday 22 November 2024, 16:04 UTC) are the system prompt to respond to the provider and Alder Compliance's 'Job is completed, I have replaced Cylinder and handles. I will drop off remaining keys to the office tomorrow.' The agency's recorded next steps (events 021-029, Saturday 23 November 04:20-04:22 UTC) thank the provider, move the job to result and final checks, skip the quote upload ('No quote required, repaired on site') and record 'Keys return confirmed' before closing. That key confirmation is time-stamped before the promised drop-off, so the rubric does not reward confirming keys that have not arrived. Expected: acknowledge Alder, record the work result, tell the tenant and landlord the lock has been replaced, and set a follow-up for the office keys (and any invoice) before closing. No escalation.
